svg.text: THE SAME TICKET AND QUESTIONS THROUGH ALL THREE CHECKPOINTS
Our run: laya 0.3.20, CPU, FP32, all three checkpoints from commit 55cf4c4e. Urgency options are levels 0–4. Multilingual's billing logit leads by 14.7.
Multilingual tokenizes the rows to 139, 141 and 122 tokens (402 input tokens); the other two match the English 141, 136 and 122.
